entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
It's defective. The cadence sensor won't sync with my app anymore. It's basically useless.
I understand your frustration. So just to confirm, it was syncing previously but has now stopped?
Yes. It's broken. I want to return it.

Okay, I can definitely look into the return options for you. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... One moment... Ah, I see you're a VIP member with us. Thank you for your continued business.

Alright, I'm just checking our policies on your VeloBand Cadence Sensor... Okay, I see here that your order was delivered 24 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe.
Since you're reporting that the item is defective, I can go ahead and process a full refund for you immediately. No need for troubleshooting.

Of course. I've just processed that for you. The prepaid return label is on its way to your email on file. And as a small apology for the trouble and a thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the defective unit back, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
